paragraphs: We are redefining the aerospace industry. We have developed an electric aircraft platform and propulsion systems that are positioned to transform the aviation industry forward into a new phase of growth. We design, manufacture and sell high-performance electric aircraft, advanced electric propulsion systems, charging systems and components. Further, we have invested in the underlying infrastructure of this breakthrough technology, which is critical to bringing electric aviation to life. We believe we have developed a differentiated presence in North America and are well positioned to expand globally.
Our company was purpose-built to capture the significant, untapped market opportunity in sustainable, reliable and efficient electric aviation.

Vertical integration allows us to innovate rapidly and capture meaningful economic value throughout an aircraft's lifetime by providing batteries and aftermarket services for BETA aircraft and other customers. Our focus is on the Enabling Technologies essential to electric aviation, including batteries, motors, flight control systems and an international network of electric charging and related equipment. With proprietary control over these core technologies, we offer customers a complete platform to support their adoption of electric aircraft to enable both existing and new missions. This multilayered approach provides us with recurring, high-margin opportunities.

We have developed highly scalable technologies that can be tailored to and deployed for cost-effective and safe missions across cargo and logistics, medical, defense and passenger end markets. Our simplified approach to designing electric aircraft allows us to service a variety of end markets and mission types leveraging the same core technologies. The portability of our technologies and systems across various aircraft also unlocks flexibility to innovate on future generations of aircraft.

We are pursuing a stepwise approach to growing our business in both certification and market entry. We believe this significantly derisks our business model and expands our addressable market. This approach creates a logical progression where each certification effort informs the next—streamlining documentation, building continuity with FAA personnel and reducing risk across programs.

Our go-to-market strategy is also incremental over time. We intend to prioritize cargo and logistics, while also giving focus to military applications and medical industries, before delivering aircraft to passenger operators.

We believe our ALIA CTOL electric aircraft is at the forefront of the electric aviation industry. The ALIA CTOL has successfully flown thousands of flights, over 100,000 nautical miles, including operations in North America, Europe and New Zealand. This includes the world's first, all-electric passenger flight into John F. Kennedy International Airport, which utilized approximately $7.00 in flight fuel costs, demonstrating electric aircraft's integration into congested national airspace and approximately 95% in fuel cost savings when compared to a combustion aircraft based on internal estimates. Our ALIA CTOL also made its debut at the Paris Air Show in June 2025, opening the show with an aerial ballet demonstrating the performance and agility of our electric aircraft. Further, our aircraft has been used by the U.S. Military in training missions and flown by the FAA, providing us with valuable data with respect to our aircraft and our certification strategy. We have also completed successful cargo and logistics demonstrations with medical partners and customers such as UPS and United Therapeutics Corporation ("United Therapeutics").

We believe our aircraft represents a significant cost efficiency advantage, as total operating costs are 42% lower compared to new conventional fixed-wing aircraft based on internal estimates. This reduction is primarily attributed to the substantially reduced maintenance requirements given our simplified aircraft design. Our aircraft's design eliminates the need for complex components such as gear boxes, in-flight liquid cooling systems and thrust vectoring mechanisms, further streamlining maintenance operations and contributing to lower operational costs. The operating savings are even higher when comparing our ALIA VTOL variant to traditional helicopters—a 74% reduction based on internal estimates.

We believe we are the first electric aircraft OEM with a scale production facility and we have room to grow. Our approximately 188,000 square foot Final Assembly Facility in South Burlington, Vermont is designed to support production of more than 300 aircraft annually at maturity through optimized processes and manufacturing flows. We have site control and permits for expansion to over 355,000 square feet to accommodate significant future growth.

Our advantage is our technology. We believe the core competency of our company and our core intellectual property are contained within our Enabling Technologies, which are fundamentally composed of four critical components:
•Batteries •Motors •Ground service equipment ("GSE") •Flight Control Systems

Together, these Enabling Technologies create a vertically-integrated ecosystem across our product lines. We designed each of these critical components for our electric aircraft and plan to use this technology in our ALIA CTOL (CX300), ALIA VTOL (A250) and MV250 aircraft, significantly reducing our overall development expense and creating economies of scale for production. Additionally, our Enabling Technologies have centralized, modular and interchangeable designs, enabling future generations of electric aircraft to incorporate our patented technologies. We also design and manufacture a line of aviation-centric charging equipment that features compatibility with a broad range of emerging electric aircraft. Our technologies are thoughtfully designed to enhance their lifetime value and long-term utility. These systems have applications across customers, sectors and geographies, which positions us for continued growth.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

We may experience significant delays in the design, manufacture, certification and commercial rollout of our aircraft, which could harm our business, brand, results of operations, financial condition and prospects.
Our limited operating history makes evaluating our business and future prospects difficult and may increase the risk of investment.
We have incurred significant losses since inception, we expect to incur losses in the future and we may not be able to achieve or maintain profitability.
Our long-term success and ability to significantly grow our revenue will depend, in part, on our ability to establish and expand our presence within international markets.
Our growing charging network is subject to location-specific risks and regulatory uncertainties.
Our competitors may commercialize their technology before us, or we may not be able to fully capture the first mover advantage that we anticipate.
Our customers' and others' perception of us and our reputation may be impacted by the broader industry and customers may not differentiate us from our competitors.
If we are unable to keep up with advances in electric aircraft technology, we may suffer a decline in our competitive position.
Demand in the electric and hybrid electric aviation (including VTOL) industry is highly volatile.
Our future success depends on the continuing efforts of our key personnel and on our ability to attract and retain highly skilled personnel and senior management.
Our business may be adversely affected by labor and union activities.
We expect to conduct a portion of our business pursuant to U.S. government contracts, which are subject to unique risks.
The U.S. government may modify or terminate one or more of our existing or future contracts.
We may be unable to secure contracts or continue to grow our relationship with the U.S. government and the U.S. Military.
paragraphs: An investment in our Class A common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks described below before making an investment decision. Our business, results of operations, financial condition or prospects could be harmed by any of these risks, as well as other risks not currently known to us or that we currently consider immaterial. The trading price of the Class A common stock could decline due to any of these risks, and, as a result, you may lose all or part of your investment. Certain statements in this "Risk Factors" section are forward-looking statements. See "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements."

Our business plan requires a significant amount of capital. We expect to require additional future funding to support our operations and implementation of our growth plans and we may be unable to access the capital and credit markets or borrow on affordable terms to obtain additional capital that we may require.

Our proposed operations and our business strategy contemplate significant manufacturing capacity and aircraft and infrastructure development, including additional vertiports where our aircraft can land, both within the U.S. and internationally. Construction of additional manufacturing and testing facilities, chargers and other facilities will require significant capital expenditures, as will future expansion of and improvements to our operations. Based on our recurring losses and management's expectations that significant on-going operating expenditures will be necessary to successfully implement our business plan and develop our powerhouses, we expect to require additional funding to continue our operations through commercialization. Although we intend to partner with or pursue leasing or other arrangements with third parties in relation to certain of our facility needs, we cannot be assured that such partnership opportunities or other arrangements will be available on commercially reasonable terms, or at all.

In addition, as our facilities and aircraft mature, our business will require capital expenditures for the maintenance, renovation and improvement of such facilities to remain competitive. This creates an ongoing need for capital, and, to the extent we cannot fund capital expenditures from cash flows from operations, we will need to borrow or otherwise obtain funds.

We expect to continue funding our operations through equity offerings or debt financings, credit or loan facilities, potential other capital resources, or a combination of one or more of these funding sources. Such financings may not be available on acceptable terms, or at all, and our failure to raise capital when needed could harm our business.

Periods of instability in the capital and credit markets (both generally and those impacting the aerospace industry in particular), including as a result of global health crises or other events contributing to the disruption and volatility of global financial markets, could limit our ability to access these markets to raise debt or equity capital on affordable terms or to obtain additional financing. Among other things, our lenders may seek to increase interest rates, enact tighter lending standards, refuse to refinance existing debt at maturity on favorable terms or at all and may reduce or cease to provide funding to us. For example, increased interest rates in 2022 and 2023 led to a widespread slowdown in investment and funding opportunities, especially for pre-revenue companies. We may sell equity securities or debt securities in one or more transactions at prices and in a manner that may materially dilute our current investors. Any debt financing, if available, may involve restrictive covenants that could reduce our operational flexibility or profitability. Debt financing, if available, may result in a significant financial burden if interest rates remain high for a prolonged period or increase in the future. We expect that our existing cash and cash equivalents, will enable us to fund our operating expenses and capital expenditure requirements for at least the next 12 months.

paragraphs: On December 2, 2025, BETA was selected by EVE to supply electric pusher motors for EVE's conforming prototypes and production aircraft. The agreement represents a potential 10-year opportunity for BETA up to $1 billion subsequent to an initial evaluation period in which EVE will purchase, test and validate the performance of BETA's motors in EVE's prototype aircraft.

During 2025, the U.S. Department of Transportation and the Federal Aviation Administration announced the eVTOL Integration Pilot Program ( the "eIPP"). The eIPP is designed to accelerate the safe integration of eVTOL and other advanced air mobility aircraft into the national airspace system, supporting continued global leadership in aviation and bringing the benefits of this technology to communities across the country. BETA is supporting state and local partners across the United States in their proposals for electric aircraft operations and infrastructure under the eIPP.

paragraphs: 我們正在重新定義航空產業。我們已開發出電動飛機平台與推進系統，這些技術被定位為推動航空產業邁向一個新的成長階段。我們設計、製造並銷售高性能電動飛機、先進電動推進系統、充電系統與零組件。此外，我們已投資於這項突破性技術的基礎設施，這對實現電動航空至關重要。我們相信我們已在北美建立了差異化的存在，並處於擴張全球的優勢位置。
本公司是專門為捕捉可持續、可靠且高效的電動航空市場機會而設立的。
垂直整合使我們能快速創新，並透過為BETA飛機及其他客戶提供電池與後市場服務，於飛機全生命週期中捕獲重要的經濟價值。我們的重點在於電動航空所必需的啟動技術，包括電池、馬達、飛行控制系統與國際電動充電及相關設備網路。透過對這些核心技術的專屬控制，我們為客戶提供完整的平台，以支持其電動飛機的採用，從而實現現有與新任務。這種多層次的策略為我們帶來持續性、高毛利率的機會。
我們已開發出高度可擴展的技術，這些技術可以根據需求進行調整，並用於貨運與物流、醫療、防禦與乘客等市場，以實現成本效益且安全的任務。我們簡化電動飛機設計的策略，使我們能服務多種終端市場與任務類型，並利用相同的基礎技術。我們技術與系統在不同飛機上的可移植性，也為我們未來世代飛機的創新提供了靈活性。
我們正在採用逐步的方式來擴大業務在認證與市場進入方面的成長。我們相信這大幅降低我們的業務模式風險，並擴大我們可接觸的市場。這種方式創造出一個邏輯性的進展，其中每個認證工作都為下一個提供資訊—簡化文件、與FAA人員建立連續性，並降低各項計畫的風險。
我們的市場進入策略也隨著時間逐步進行。我們計畫優先處理貨運與物流，同時也著重於軍事應用與醫療產業，之後再向乘客運營商交付飛機。

我們相信我們的ALIA CTOL電動飛機處於電動航空產業的最前線。ALIA CTOL已成功飛行數千次航班，總計超過100,000海里，包括北美、歐洲與紐西蘭的運作。這包括世界上首架全電動乘客航班飛入約翰·F·肯尼迪國際機場，該航班使用約7.00美元的飛行燃料成本，展示電動飛機整合至繁忙國家空域的能力，並根據內部估計，與傳統飛機相比，燃料成本節省約95%。我們的ALIA CTOL也在2025年6月的巴黎航空展上亮相，以空中芭蕾表演展示我們電動飛機的性能與靈活性。此外，我們的飛機已用於美國軍隊的訓練任務，並由FAA飛行，為我們提供有關飛機與認證策略的寶貴數據。我們也已與醫療合作夥伴與客戶如UPS與United Therapeutics Corporation（"United Therapeutics"）成功完成貨運與物流的演示。
我們相信我們的飛機代表著顯著的成本效益優勢，根據內部估計，總運營成本比新傳統固定翼飛機低42%。這項減少主要歸因於我們簡化飛機設計所導致的大幅降低的維護需求。我們飛機的設計消除了如齒輪箱、飛行中液冷系統與推力向量機制等複雜零組件，進一步簡化維護作業，並有助於降低運營成本。當比較我們的ALIA VTOL變體與傳統直升機時，運營節省甚至更高—根據內部估計，節省達74%。
我們認為本公司是第一家擁有規模生產設施的電動飛機原廠製造商，且仍有成長空間。本公司位於佛蒙特州南伯靈頓約 188,000 平方英呎的最終組裝廠，設計用以透過最佳化流程與製造流程，於成熟階段每年支持生產超過 300 架飛機。本公司擁有擴建至超過 355,000 平方英呎的場地控制權與許可證，以因應未來的重大成長需求。
我們的優勢在於我們的技術。我們認為本公司核心競爭力與核心智慧財產權均包含於我們的 Enabling Technologies，其根本組成為四種關鍵零組件：
•電池 •馬達 •地面服務設備（"GSE"） •飛行控制系統

這些 Enabling Technologies 共同構成我們產品線的垂直整合生態系統。我們為電動飛機設計了每種關鍵零組件，並計畫將此技術應用於 ALIA CTOL (CX300)、ALIA VTOL (A250) 以及 MV250 飛機，大幅降低我們整體的開發費用，並為生產創造規模經濟。此外，我們的 Enabling Technologies 具備集中化、模組化與可交換設計，使未來世代的電動飛機能整合我們的專利技術。我們亦設計與製造一系列以航空為導向的充電設備，具備與廣泛新興電動飛機相容的特性。我們的技術被精心設計以提升其全生命週期價值與長期使用效益。這些系統在客戶、產業與地理區域均有應用，使我們能持續成長。

paragraphs: 於 2025 年 12 月 2 日，BETA 被 EVE 選定，供應電動推進馬達給 EVE 的符合規範的原型機與生產飛機。此協議代表 BETA 有潛在 10 年的機會，總計達 1 十億美元，此後需經過一初始評估期，在此期間 EVE 將購買、測試並驗證 BETA 馬達在 EVE 原型飛機上的表現。
2025年，美國運輸部與聯邦航空管理局宣佈了eVTOL整合試點計畫（the "eIPP"）。eIPP旨在加速eVTOL及其他先進空中運輸飛機安全整合至國家空域系統，支持持續在全球航空領域的領導地位，並將此技術的效益帶給全國各地的社區。BETA正在支持美國各州與地方夥伴，協助他們提出電動飛機運作與基礎建設的提案，以符合eIPP的相關要求。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
我們可能在飛機的設計、製造、認證及商業推廣過程中遭遇顯著延遲，這可能會對我們的業務、品牌、營運成果、財務狀況及前景造成損害。
我們有限的營運歷史使評估我們的業務及未來前景變得困難，並可能增加投資風險。
自成立以來，我們已產生顯著虧損，我們預期未來仍將持續虧損，且可能無法實現或維持盈利。
我們的長期成功及大幅成長營收的能力，在一定程度上取決於我們能否在國際市場建立並擴大我們的影響力。
我們日益增長的充電網路面臨地區性風險及法規不確定性。
我們的競爭對手可能在我們之前商業化其技術，或我們可能無法完全把握我們預期的先發優勢。
我們的客戶及其他人士對我們的觀感及聲譽可能受到整個產業的影響，客戶可能無法將我們與競爭對手區分開來。
若我們無法跟上電動飛機技術的進步，我們可能面臨競爭地位下降的風險。
電動及混合電動航空（包括 VTOL）產業的 demand 非常不穩定。
我們未來的成功取決於關鍵人員的持續努力，以及我們吸引並留住高技能人員及高階管理階層的能力。
我們的業務可能因勞動及工會活動而受到負面影響。
我們預期將部分業務依賴美國政府契約進行，而這些契約具有獨特的風險。
美國政府可能修改或終止我們現有或未來的其中一個或多個契約。
我們可能無法取得契約，或持續拓展與美國政府及美國軍方的關係。
paragraphs: 投資本公司 A 級普通股涉及高度風險。您應在做出投資決定前，謹慎考慮下列所列風險。本公司業務、營運結果、財務狀況或前景可能因任何上述風險，以及目前尚未知悉或本公司認為不重要之其他風險而受到損害。A 級普通股之交易價格可能因任何上述風險而下跌，因此您可能損失全部或部分投資。本「風險因素」部分中某些陳述為前瞻性陳述。請參閱「關於前瞻性陳述之特別說明」。
本公司業務計畫需要大量資金。我們預期未來將需要額外資金以支應營運及執行成長計畫，我們可能無法取得資本與信貸市場或以可負擔之條件借款以獲得所需之額外資金。

我們預期之業務運作及業務策略包含大量製造能力與飛機及基礎建設之發展，包括本公司飛機可降落之額外垂直起降機場，於美國與國際皆然。建設額外製造與測試設施、充電站及其他設施將需要大量資本支出，未來擴張及改善本公司營運亦將如此。根據我們持續虧損及管理階層預期將需要大量持續營運支出以成功執行業務計畫及發展我們之電力設施，我們預期將需要額外資金以持續營運至商業化。雖然我們有意與第三方合作或尋求租賃或其他安排以應對部分設施需求，但我們無法保證這些合作機會或其他安排將在商業合理條件下或任何情況下可用。
此外，隨著我們之設施與飛機成熟，本公司業務將需要資本支出以維持設施之維護、翻修及改善，以保持競爭力。這會產生持續之資金需求，若我們無法從營運現金流支應資本支出，我們將需要借款或其他方式取得資金。
我們預期將透過股票發行或債務融資、信用或貸款設施、潛在其他資金來源，或這些資金來源之組合來支應營運。這些融資可能無法在可接受之條件下或任何情況下取得，若我們無法在需要時籌措資金，將會損害本公司業務。

資本與信貸市場之不穩定時期（包括一般情況及特別影響航空產業之情況），包括因全球健康危機或其他事件導致全球金融市場之動盪與波動，可能限制我們取得這些市場以以可負擔條件發行債務或股票資本或取得額外融資之能力。其他方面，我們之貸款人可能要求提高利率、實施更嚴格之貸款標準、拒絕以有利條件重組現有債務或完全拒絕重組，或減少或停止提供資金給我們。例如，2022 年及 2023 年之利率上升導致投資與融資機會普遍放緩，特別是對尚未有營收之公司。我們可能在一個或多個交易中出售股票證券或債務證券，其價格及方式可能對現有投資人造成重大稀釋。若可取得債務融資，可能涉及限制性契約，可能降低我們之營運彈性或利潤率。若可取得債務融資，若利率在長時間內保持高水準或未來上升，可能造成重大財務負擔。我們預期本公司現有之現金及現金等價物，將足以支應我們至少未來 12 個月之營運費用及資本支出需求。
